info.name: Birhane Hiwot Sunday School - QA API
info.description:
QA Postman collection for the Birhane Hiwot Sunday School Attendance Management System (ብርሃነ ሕይወት ሰንበት ትምህርት ቤት የአቴንዳንስ እና የትምህርት ክፍል አስተዳደር ሲስተም).

## Setup
1. Import this collection and `Birhane-Hiwot.postman_environment.json`.
2. Verify environment variables (`baseUrl`, test account emails & passwords).
3. Run **Setup → Create Super Admin (one-time)** if initializing a fresh database.
4. Run **Auth → Get CSRF Token**, then **Auth → Login (Credentials)** before running role-protected web endpoints.
5. Alternatively, run **Auth → Mobile Login (JWT)** to test the mobile token workflow.

## Managed Roles
- Super Admin (ሊቀ ትጉሃን ገብረመስቀል)
- HR Admin (ቀሲስ ዳዊት በቀለ)
- Education Admin (ሊቀ ዲያቆናት ሰለሞን)
- Attendance Facilitator (ዲ/ን ቴዎድሮስ ካሳሁን)
- Education Facilitator (መርጌታ ዘርዓይ በርሄ)
- Teacher (መምህር አስፋው ወልደሥላሴ)
